From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood estimate & quick recap — open 15-minute windows?

Hi Maya / Evan,

Thanks again for your time this morning — good to learn more about BrightBridge's ingestion cadence and the tolerance you mentioned for 200ms token p99 on your real-time enrichment pipeline. Per our discussion, attaching a calibrated estimate and a short commercial summary so you can share with the procurement & infra leads. Key highlights: 

- Recommended config: 2x gP4d-like instances under Redwood Dedicated (reserved commit) for steady-state throughput, with a small burst pool for traffic spikes.
- Typical latency: 85–120ms p95 for your 512-token average prompt with continuous KV caching.
- Estimated cost: see page 3 of the attached PDF; first-year blended unit economics included.

Attachments: BrightBridge_Redwood_Estimate_20280419.pdf (estimate + assumptions), redwood-commercial-summary.xlsx (SLA & add-ons).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm receipt of the two files — I want to make sure they landed with your procurement team.
2) If useful, I can walk engineering + procurement through the model/ops assumptions in a 15-minute call — I have availability next Tue/Wed afternoon PT.
3) If budget or scope needs adjusting, we can map an alternate config or a phased rollout.

If it's easier, here are a couple of 15-minute windows I can offer next week:
- Tue 4/25 10:00–10:15 AM PT
- Tue 4/25 3:00–3:15 PM PT
- Wed 4/26 11:00–11:15 AM PT

Would any of those work? If not, tell me a time that does and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing whether you want a short walkthrough.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0173
